scheme_name: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Accident Assistance
other_conditions: The victim must have suffered a serious injury or death due to an accident.

Assistance for death is payable only to dependent parents, spouse, son or daughter of the deceased (grandparents or dependent siblings may be considered under special circumstances with CM’s consent).
The applicant must submit the request within six months of the accident date.
Applications can be made to the Tehsil/District Collector’s Office, the Chief Minister’s Office, or via the official email address.
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time assistance of ₹1,00,000 to dependents in case of death and up to ₹20,000 for serious injury, disbursed by the district collector.
